Weapon and soldier models by Quaternius: Toon Shooter Game Kit (December 2022).
Creative Commons Zero 1.0 Universal (CC0).
https://quaternius.com/packs/toonshootergamekit.html
https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/

DOCKLINE adaptations: compact local geometry, receiver recoloring, separated
magazines, first-person grip and sight fitting, team colors, weapon scale,
animation selection and blending. Editable OBJ/MTL and glTF source files are
included in art-source/toon-shooter. Low-spec sprites and armory thumbnails
are rendered from the same weapon models.
